newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hutchison trims stake in Asia Satellite.
newsitem.headline: Hutchison trims stake in Asia Satellite.

text.p: Hutchison Whampoa Ltd has exercised an option to sell part of its stake in Asia Satellite Telecommunications Holdings Ltd to China International Trust and Investment Corp (CITIC) for US$102 million.
Asia Satellite said Hutchison has exercised its option to sell a 15 percent stake in Bowenvale Ltd to CITIC's wholly-owned Shortridge Ltd for US$102 million.
Bowenvale, which holds 69 percent of Asia Satellite, was 48.3 percent owned by Hutchison, 33.3 percent by Cable & Wireless Plc and 18.3 percent by CITIC prior to the deal.
Asia Satellite said Cable & Wireless, CITIC and Hutchison would hold the issued share capital of Bowenvale in equal proportions after the option was exercised.
According to the Asia Satellite listing prospectus in June, Hutchison's put option could be exercised up to January 31, 1997.
